author: yorickdowne
content:
Sure. For our purposes here. Zen 4/5 is AM5 socket, quite recent. *Some* home stakers use AMD CPUs. Usually mobile, the PN50 boxen. Those are Zen 2, so no AVX512. PN54 has AVX512 bcs AM5 socket; I have yet to see anyone mention PN54. Doesn't mean they don't exist.

*Some* home stakers are on Intel NUC10/11, those would have AVX512. The bulk are on NUC12 or newer, so no AVX512.

I don't have a breakdown of who uses what hardware, not in detail. This is from what I see in the Ethstaker and RocketPool Discords.

I don't know what people run that don't stake, but let's say Moxie Marlinspike was right and "people don't want to run servers". If home stakers are a special breed, people running an Ethereum node at home for their own RPC are going to be extremely rare. Sorry, Potuz 😅 . 'tis how it is.

author: yorickdowne
content: On the cloud/data center side it looks better. Both Xeon Scalable and AMD Epyc have AVX512. I don't know that "optimizing for data center CPUs" is the play here, however.
